definitions.conservation: playing: sum stacks + pot = 100000; done: sum stacks = 100000, residual displayed pot excluded
definitions.directTargetPressure: heroFacesTargetWager requires immediately governing last street aggressor to be target and Hero toCall positive; third-party reraises replace lastAggressor and are excluded
definitions.targetRespondsToHeroWager: target acts while governing last aggressor is Hero and toCall positive; includes calls, folds and reraises
definitions.coReach: both Hero and target have not folded at entry to a street actually dealt; all-ins count as reaching streets
definitions.naturalHands: all starts count, including B109 walk with zero Hero decision; no skipped or selected deals

deviations.effect: one read-only GET returned only start instruction; no deal started; no game information exposed
